evidence.title: Benson, James spar in Michigan gubernatorial debate: 3 takeaways

occurrences.checkable_against: Michigan state fuel tax statute and WOOD-TV debate recording or transcript
occurrences.quote_span: In backing a suspension of the state fuel tax of roughly 52 cents per gallon, James noted such a move could lead to Michigan gas prices falling below $4 on average.
occurrences.speaker: John James
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Trade Representative correspondence or debate recording
occurrences.quote_span: James broke with the Trump administration regarding the president’s tariffs on Canadian imports, saying he has urged U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer to return to negotiations.
occurrences.speaker: John James
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. House roll-call votes and war powers resolutions; WOOD-TV debate recording
occurrences.quote_span: “We need to be clear how we got here. It’s because of a reckless war in Iran that my opponent has voted six times to support, and that is directly to blame for the rising cost of gas and oil in this nation right now,” the Michigan secretary of state said early in the debate.
occurrences.speaker: Jocelyn Benson
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: The Hill analyst comments and retail gasoline price data

figure.unit: full pass-through of suspended gas tax

occurrences.quote_span: But analysts have told The Hill that gas stations may not pass off the entire suspended gas tax to consumers.
occurrences.speaker: The Hill's analysts
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: WOOD-TV debate recording or transcript and Iran conflict timeline
occurrences.quote_span: When moderator Rick Albin asked James if there was an issue he disagreed with the president on, the congressman pointed to the seven-plus-month Iran conflict.
occurrences.speaker: John James
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: John James congressional service records and debate recording
occurrences.quote_span: “We must get back to the table, stop acting like children and negotiate a reciprocal, fair and mutually beneficial arrangement, to make sure that we can bring our jobs back and protect our industry,” the three-term representative said of what he told Greer.
occurrences.speaker: John James
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: AAA gasoline price data
occurrences.quote_span: A gallon of regular gas costs roughly $4.43 on average in Michigan as of Wednesday, above the national average of about $4.37 per gallon, according to data from AAA.
occurrences.speaker: AAA
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: WOOD-TV debate recording or transcript
occurrences.quote_span: “I have called on both the suspension of the federal and the state gas tax,” James said later in the debate.
occurrences.speaker: John James
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: WOOD-TV debate recording or transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Benson noted she was “open” to suspending the state fuel tax, while saying the federal government must “take responsibility” for elevated prices amid the war.
occurrences.speaker: Jocelyn Benson
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: Nexstar WOOD-TV debate recording or transcript
occurrences.quote_span: During the debate, which Nexstar’s WOOD-TV hosted, the candidates touched on issues specific to the state — such as when Benson vowed to improve the efficiency of the Michigan Department and Health and Human Services and James pledged to cut taxes.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. House roll-call votes and WOOD-TV debate recording
occurrences.quote_span: James defended his votes, saying they stemmed from his desire to keep funding the military while troops “were in harm’s way.”
occurrences.speaker: John James
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. House roll-call votes and war powers resolutions
occurrences.quote_span: But Benson criticized her Republican opponent for voting six times against House war powers resolutions aimed at forcing the president to wind down the conflict.
occurrences.speaker: Jocelyn Benson
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: WOOD-TV debate recording and Michigan gubernatorial campaign platform
occurrences.quote_span: Benson blasted Trump’s import taxes and promised to negotiate a “subnational agreement” with Canada if elected governor.
occurrences.speaker: Jocelyn Benson
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: WOOD-TV debate recording or transcript
occurrences.quote_span: “My opponent could go, as I’ve asked him and others to do, to Washington tomorrow and eliminate or put a holiday on the federal gas tax, which would also provide necessary relief for Michigan families and families all across this nation,” Benson remarked.
occurrences.speaker: Jocelyn Benson
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: WOOD-TV debate recording or transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Both candidates backed suspending the federal gas tax, as Michiganders face high prices at the pump amid the Iran war.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: Canadian government trade data by sector
occurrences.quote_span: More than half of that is concentrated in the vehicles sector, including trucks, automobiles, engines and turbines.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: John James military service records and debate recording
occurrences.quote_span: A former Army officer who served in Iraq, James said he will work with Trump to “do what we can” to end the war.
occurrences.speaker: John James
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: WOOD-TV debate recording or transcript and presidential tariff proclamation
occurrences.quote_span: James did not explicitly say whether he supported Trump’s proposed 50 percent tariffs on Canadian automobiles, set to go into effect on Jan. 1, 2027.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: WOOD-TV debate recording or transcript
occurrences.quote_span: “Iran cannot have a nuke, but we need to wrap this thing up … yesterday,” James said, after praising the administration for exerting economic and diplomatic pressure on the Islamic Republic.
occurrences.speaker: John James
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: AAA diesel price data
occurrences.quote_span: Diesel fuel costs nearly $6.60 per gallon in the state, almost 30 cents higher than the national average.
occurrences.speaker: AAA
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: WOOD-TV debate recording or transcript
occurrences.quote_span: “I’m always open to finding any way to reduce costs as well, here in Michigan, and I’m looking forward to having those conversations with folks on both sides of the aisle in [the state capital,] Lansing,” the Democrat said.
occurrences.speaker: Jocelyn Benson
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: WOOD-TV debate recording and Michigan gubernatorial campaign platform
occurrences.quote_span: “It will enable us to ensure goods going between Michigan and Canada, and back and forth, are protected from these tariffs, from the John James tax, that has driven up costs and cost Michiganders jobs,” she added.
occurrences.speaker: Jocelyn Benson
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James

occurrences.checkable_against: Canadian government trade data
occurrences.quote_span: Canada is Michigan’s top trading partner, as businesses in the state export $21.2 billion worth of goods to America’s northern neighbor annually, according to data from the Canadian government.
occurrences.speaker: Canadian government
occurrences.subject: 2026 Michigan gubernatorial debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James
